5987.title: Native skill paths are omitted from server dispatch
5987.rootCauseOneLine: Both server dispatch builders forward native skill mentions without resolving their host file paths or adding agent-only context.
5987.proposedFix: Enrich outbound prompts through the existing host-native skill discovery service, with agent-only path context and a skill-list fallback.
5987.caveats: Server-boundary reproduction only; no live model. Fix attempt stopped because required cache-dependency wiring exceeded the simple-fix scope. Reproduction source and output are inline per report repository policy.
